title: NASA Studies Strawberries and Cucumbers for Space Menus
paragraphs: NASA wants fresh food for astronauts. Plants can grow in space. They make oxygen and clean the air.
Scientists test strawberries. A strawberry called Delizz has big red fruit. It is the best choice now.
They also test cucumbers and lemon basil. Nobody has grown a cucumber in space yet. Fresh food can make astronauts happy.
